title.full: Using MediSave for a family member

summary.text: You can use your MediSave for your approved family members' outpatient treatment if they do not have enough.

details.heading: Approved family members
details.body: Approved dependants refer to a member’s spouse, children, parents, grandparents and siblings. Grandparents and siblings must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents.

details.heading: Withdrawal limits
details.body: The amount they can use is subject to the MediSave withdrawal limits, applied on a per patient basis.

steps.name: Sign form
steps.text: Approach the medical institution where your family member is receiving treatment to sign the Medical Claims Authorisation Form.

example_phrasings: Can I use my MediSave to pay for my family member’s outpatient treatment expenses?
Can I use my MediSave for my family member's outpatient bills?
Can family use my MediSave for outpatient care?

sources.page_title: Can I use my MediSave to pay for my family member’s outpatient treatment expenses?

quotes.text: If your approved dependants do not have sufficient MediSave for their outpatient treatment expenses, you may consider using your MediSave to pay for them.
you may approach the Medical Institution (MI) where they are receiving treatment at to sign the Medical Claims Authorisation Form (MCAF).

Approved dependants refer to a member’s spouse, children, parents, grandparents and siblings. They can be of any nationality except for grandparents and siblings who must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents.
the amount they can use is subject to the MediSave withdrawal limits, which is applied on a per patient basis regardless of the number of payers.
